title: Lifecycle Lattice: Initiative Mapping for Cost Optimization
creator: Eleanor Ng
description:
This ticket defines a cross-cycle initiative tracker (the "Lifecycle Lattice") to map batching, KV-caching, and quantization work into explicit OKR lanes, decision gates, and rollout bands. The goal is to provide a single source of truth for which experiments are in-field, which are gated by quality/regression thresholds, and how savings are attributed to releases and customers. The lattice ties experiments (A/B, canary, full rollouts) to measurable metrics (tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, latency p95, quality regression delta) and enumerates the minimal artifacts required for a safe rollout: eval suites, rollout playbooks, rollback criteria, telemetry dashboards, and runbooks.

Why: PMs and Eng leaders report difficulty answering two questions during weekly reviews: (1) which active initiatives will materially change unit economics this quarter, and (2) what are the exact gating checks that prevent customer regressions. Current trackers are fragmented across spreadsheets, PR descriptions, and Confluence notes. The lattice is an attempt to normalize tracking and accelerate decision cycles across Dedicated and Hosted product lines.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A canonical lattice spreadsheet and dashboard exist and are linked in this ticket; 2) At least 6 active experiments (mix of batching/caching/quant) are onboarded with owner, hypothesis, target metric and rollback criteria; 3) Each experiment lists dependent infra/eng stories and an approximate cost delta projection; 4) Weekly sync template with OKR mapping is adopted by at least two product squads; 5) One pilot canary rollout executed against non-critical traffic demonstrating measurable cost delta and no quality regression >0.5% on calibrated evals.
milestones: Design lattice schema and column taxonomy (owner, hypothesis, target, rollout band, gating metrics)
Implement Google Sheet + readonly dashboard with auto-refresh from telemetry
Onboard first 6 experiments and map to OKRs
Run first canary and capture results in dashboard
Document rollout + rollback playbooks and circulate for review
experiment_matrix: BATCH-OPT-01: dynamic micro-batching for short prompt workloads — owner: ML Eng — hypothesis: 18-25% token-econ savings without p95 > 50ms regression
CACHE-EXP-03: KV prefix caching for conversational sessions — owner: Backend Eng — hypothesis: 10-15% call reduction for repeated prefixes; guard: stale-cache detection and TTL tuning
QUANT-PRF-02: mixed-precision quant profile for Llama-variant — owner: Infra Eng — hypothesis: 20-40% GPU memory reduction with <1% quality delta on endpoint evals
rollout_policy: Three-band rollout: (A) Lab -> perf/eval harness (signal nominal), (B) Canary: 5-10% non-critical traffic with live shadow quality sampling, automatic rollback if regression > threshold or latency SLO breach for 3 consecutive windows, (C) Graduated ramp to 100% with staged increases and golden-checkpoint comparison. Each band must have an assigned owner, runbook, and monitoring alerts. For Dedicated customers, use gating that includes contract-level guardrails and opt-in toggles.
metrics_and_slos: quality_delta_eval_score (acceptable delta <= 0.5% measured on calibration set)
customer_errors_impact (flag if any customer-visible errors occur)
risks: Undetected quality regressions from skewed eval sets — mitigation: expand calibration sets and shadow sampling
Cascade rollbacks in Dedicated fleets — mitigation: per-customer opt-out and gradual ramp controls
Telemetry lag causing late detection of regressions — mitigation: reduce telemetry pipeline windows and add synthetic traffic probes
Over-attribution of savings due to confounding changes — mitigation: require A/B with traffic holdouts before claiming savings
